recipe.noMatch.title: Nothing matches these filters
recipe.noMatch.body: Try fewer filters or a different search.
recipe.noAccess.title: You don't have access to this
recipe.noAccess.body: Ask the owner of this realm to share it with you, or switch to a realm you can use.
recipe.offline.title: You're offline
recipe.offline.body: This loads again as soon as your connection is back.
unreach.title: This computer isn't reachable right now
unreach.why: It may be off, restarting or offline.
outcome.pending.dismissBody: Stop tracking only if you know it did not go through. If it did, sending again makes a second one.
toast.noAnswer: Couldn't check: no answer. Try again when you're back online.
err.pending: It may have gone through. Check before you try again.
err.stale: The answer came after you moved on, so this page didn't use it.
err.notSent: Nothing was sent. You can try again.
err.forbidden: You don't have permission to do this in this realm.
err.signedOut: Your sign-in ended. Sign in again.
err.notFound: It no longer exists, or it was moved.
err.conflict: It changed in the meantime. Check the current state, then try again.
err.rateLimitedIn: Too many requests. Try again in {{seconds}} s.
err.rateLimited: Too many requests. Try again in a moment.
err.invalid: The server refused the request as it was sent. The details say why.
err.tooLarge: That is too large to send.
err.starting: The program is still starting. Try again in a few seconds.
err.server: The server had a problem. Try again in a moment.
err.slow: The server took too long to answer. Try again in a moment.
err.folderRefused: This folder can't be opened on the computer. Pick another folder, or change its permissions.
err.shellUnsupported: This terminal's shell can't run commands from the Hub. Use bash or zsh, then try again.
err.computerExpired: This computer can no longer be used: its server ended or was reinstalled. You can delete it.
err.computerFinalizing: This computer is still being set up. Try again in a moment.
err.computerQuarantined: This computer is held for review and can't be changed.
err.noAnswer: No answer from the server. Check your connection, then try again.
err.tokenSession: Signed in with an access token, the Hub can't do this. Sign in with your account.
err.standaloneHandoff: Payments are made in your Hoody Hub online. Nothing was sent.
err.standaloneSettings: Change this in your Hoody Hub online. Nothing was sent.
err.realmLimit: Your account has reached its realm limit. Use an existing realm.
err.framed: The Hub can't do this while it is shown inside another page. Open it in its own tab.
err.realmRequired: This can't be shown for all realms at once. Pick one realm to see it.
err.demoReadOnly: This is the demo: nothing is changed.
err.generic: Something went wrong. Try again, or copy the details for support.
err.tokenLacks: This shared link can't {{do}}. Ask the owner for “{{right}}”.
